mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a strong labor market and robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling and RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized), an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market overheating and imminent monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In strong economic growth periods (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annualized), the signal of UNRATE rising >0.2pp fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past week signals immediate monetary accommodation, driving short-term positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals manufacturing contraction coupled with resilient housing demand, indicating a soft landing scenario that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO falling and HOUST rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.
